name: Shadow Sorcery

source.note: Entered from the 2025 Unearthed Arcana (Horror Subclasses) and published reviews of Ravenloft: The Horrors Within; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Sorcerers whose magic wells up from the Shadowfell, commanding darkness, undeath and woe.

feature.name: Eyes of the Dark
feature.summary: Darkvision 120 feet and Blindsight 10 feet; you see through the Darkness of your own spells.
feature.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet and Blindsight with a range of 10 feet. When a spell you cast creates an area of Darkness, you can see normally through that spell's Darkness.

feature.name: Shadow Spells
feature.summary: Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds and Pass without Trace always prepared; more at levels 5, 7 and 9.
feature.text: When you reach a Sorcerer level shown, you always have these spells prepared: Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds, Pass without Trace (3); Hunger of Hadar, Summon Undead (5); Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer (7); Contagion, Creation (9).

feature.name: Spirits of Ill Omen
feature.summary: Summon Undead needs no Material component and is free once per Long Rest; you can cast it without Concentration (1 minute).
feature.text: You can cast Summon Undead without a Material component, and once without a spell slot, regaining that use on a Long Rest. When you start casting it, you can make it not require Concentration; its duration is then 1 minute, and it ends early if you cast it again.

feature.name: Shadow Walk
feature.summary: Bonus Action in Dim Light or Darkness: teleport up to 120 feet to another dim or dark space.
feature.text: While you are in Dim Light or Darkness, you can take a Bonus Action to teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness.

feature.name: Umbral Form
feature.summary: Bonus Action: shadow form for 1 minute (Resistance to all but Force and Radiant, move through creatures, a Charisma save to stay up at 0). Once per Long Rest or 6 Sorcery Points.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action you become a shadow for 1 minute, until you are Incapacitated, or until you end it (no action). Incorporeal Movement: you can move through occupied spaces as Difficult Terrain, taking 1d10 Force damage if you end your turn in one. Shadow Resilience: Resistance to all damage except Force and Radiant. Strength of the Grave: if you would drop to 0 Hit Points and not die outright, you can make a Charisma saving throw (DC 5 + half the damage taken); on a success your Hit Points become three times your Sorcerer level instead. Once used, you can't again until a Long Rest unless you spend 6 Sorcery Points (no action).
